description: Find EV charging stations along a route defined by a series of waypoints. Useful for trip planning. Searches within a corridor around the route. Within each route segment, stations whose verified owner is on Listed Pro come first. Each station has verified_owner and owner_profile.

available_now.description: Only stations showing a free port in a live reading under 15 minutes old. Live availability is commercially licensed: requires a paid API key.

corridor_miles.description: Width of search corridor in miles from route (default 5, max 25)

limit_per_waypoint.description: Max stations per waypoint segment (default 5, max 10)

min_power_kw.description: Minimum charger power in kW (e.g. 50, 150, 250). 150 and up only match stations with a known wattage.

speed.description: Charging level: dcfc (DC fast), level2 or level1

waypoints.description: Array of {lat, lng} coordinates defining the route

name: find_stations_on_route
title: Stations along a route
